## What ingredients should you look for?

| Ingredient | Benefit |
|--------|--------|
| Ceramides | Supports skin barrier |
| Hyaluronic acid | Attracts moisture |
| Glycerin | Hydrates dry skin |
| Squalane | Softens skin |
| Colloidal oatmeal | Soothes irritation |
| Petrolatum | Prevents moisture loss |


Avoid heavily fragranced moisturizers, essential oils and harsh exfoliating products if your skin is easily irritated.
